Open decisions these rules rely on: DL01 (ASM-0189, ASM-1230, ASM-1770, ASM-1988) and DL23 (ASM-1232, ASM-1237, ASM-1259, ASM-1560). Each assumption applies while its decision is still open.

edits.old: The suite owns no field and no table: every row is seeded synthetically by the harness RWB-ITG-W1J01-ITG or read through an owner's contract, and no production value is used.
edits.new: The suite owns no field and no table: every row is seeded synthetically by the harness RWB-ITG-W1J01-ITG or read through an owner's contract, and no production value is used. The legacy ROLE and TEAM data split is fixed as follows: roles, permissions, scope, masking and delegation stay in `rwb_access` (P4); `rwb_case` keeps TEAM as reference data and keeps only `role_code` as a code on the queue, validated at load time over the rwb-access authorise contract (DP-08) and never copied into a table; the column list is confirmed with P4 in RWB-P4-E1037-CON. The queue_measure columns are those of TSD P3 v3 T3.1 (DF-RPT-020 to DF-RPT-030 with LOV-SNAPSHOT-STATUS); the lov_value columns are DF-REF-028 and DF-REF-029 at minimum; the measure grain is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0680), and any further column comes by a later migration.

edits.old: **Database.** None of its own. The suite writes no service table and no schema object.
edits.new: **Database.** None of its own. The suite writes no service table and no schema object. The schemas named in this section are owned by the services that hold them: `rwb_case` by RWB-P3-E1019-APP, `rwb_access` by RWB-P4-E1019-APP and `rwb_comms` by RWB-P6-E1019-APP (DP-01); the suite owns none of them.

edits.old: - The 2 s client budget, the poll interval and the wait window of the run.
edits.new:
- The 2 s client budget, the poll interval and the wait window of the run.
- The Queues template: one xlsx workbook with sheets QUEUE and QUEUE_MEMBER, one header row per sheet, one column per queue and queue_member field and one check per required column; the column order and header names are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0681), and the v1 contract accepts the file as multipart.
- Rollback and verify of reference loads (POST /api/recovery/case/v1/admin/reference-loads/{loadId}/rollback and .../verify) are owned by rwb-case (P3); until a later rwb-case contract story publishes them, AC2 and AC7 run against the contract fake and this story does not claim the operation.
